stories.title: Define Brand Naming Audit Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a standard schema for detecting and reporting naming inconsistencies (e.g., 'ChatHealthy.ai' vs 'ChatHealthy'), including artifact source, violation type, severity, and normalized canonical form.

stories.title: Implement Brand Name Detection and Validation Logic
stories.description: Build logic to scan text artifacts and detect improper brand usage, enforcing the rule that only 'ChatHealthy.ai' is valid, with normalization and false-positive safeguards.

stories.title: Expose Brand Audit Results via API and Admin UI
stories.description: Provide an API and admin-facing output to view detected brand inconsistencies across artifacts, including file location, violation details, and suggested correction based on canonical naming.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Brand Audit
stories.description: Create tests validating detection accuracy, normalization, false positive prevention, and correct reporting of naming violations across representative artifacts.

stories.title: Integrate Brand Audit into Manifest and Brain Scan Workflow
stories.description: Integrate the brand audit process into manifest generation and Brain artifact scanning so audits run automatically during pipeline execution and results are persisted for review.
